limitations.en: Modern spelling or sound resemblance is not a regular sound correspondence and does not prove cognacy.

claim.en: The author's comparison around 干 gan，gun、gin，gen，generate; generate ↔ 干 gan / 根 gen; 辅音不变规则同样适用于词根的意义;  may support a mnemonic or semantic association without establishing common origin.
claim.zh-Hans: 作者观察“干 gan，gun、gin，gen，generate。generate ↔ 干 gan / 根 gen。辅音不变规则同样适用于词根的意义。”可作为记忆或语义联想，但不建立共同来源。

counterexamples: Modern resemblance does not establish generate ← 根/干 or a shared historical root.
